name: taslama
description: Connect to Taslama through project-scoped OAuth and manage service-business operations with Codex.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to a selected Taslama project through OAuth and use contextual WebMCP tools in the authenticated admin app. Review and manage localized catalogs, media, staff, customers, bookings, orders, landing content, and site settings with current project permissions.
defaultPrompt: Review today's Taslama bookings and flag issues.
Review recent Taslama orders and flag operational issues.
Audit my Taslama catalog for missing content.
Update Taslama content after showing me the changes.
